name: Wings Mix
notes: All 4 photos show the same three-panel painted/printed menu board, re-photographed at different times with successively different (rising) prices; photo 1 has the highest prices and was used as the primary/current source, since it is also the sharpest capture. The Sauces flavor list (Mild, Medium, Hot, BBQ, etc.) is a flavor/heat selector with no prices and was skipped as a modifier list. The Master Baby Back Ribs item was illegible in photo 1 (covered by an inset photo/sticker), so its price was taken from photo 4, the only photo where it was legible; it may be an older price. A second, non-drink-combo pricing table for Tenders/Wings (a la carte, without fries/drink) duplicated the same item names at different prices and was skipped to avoid ambiguous duplicates. Drinks (Soda Can, Mex Bottle, Horchata) had their prices blacked out/illegible in every photo, so are listed without a price.
